profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Applied Machine Learning & AI Systems | M.S. Artificial Intelligence Engineering
profile.summary:
Software engineer focused on building scalable systems and delivering meaningful, user-centered solutions. I take a pragmatic approach to complex problems, working across the stack and choosing the right tools for each context. 

I'm experienced in backend platforms, modern frontends, and data-driven architecture, including applied AI. I thrive in collaborative teams where engineers contribute to technical direction, own outcomes, and ship with purpose.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Strategic Planning · System Architecture · Software Development · Software Design

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Mentor Collective is the leading provider of impact-driven mentoring programs. MC partners with universities to provide all students with a relevant, trained peer, professional, or alumni mentor.

Mentor Collective partner institutions have seen an average reduction in melt rates of -13.79% and an average effect on retention of +3.84%, with a total of over 75,000 mentorships created since inception in 2015.

positions.title: Web Development Tutor
positions.description:
• Identifying individual student needs and strategizing on how to close specific skill gaps by suggesting supplementary learning materials for areas where students may be struggling.
• Evaluating student work and giving actionable suggestions to improve the quality of student submissions and portfolio projects.
• Working closely with mentors to provide guidance and advice to students on creating an job-ready portfolio of project work in line with current industry standards and best practices.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon EC2 · Amazon S3 · Skill Development

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Lead the design and implementation of gamified job board using NextJS and GraphQL to increase the engagement with associates and generate great matches between candidates and employers.
• Lead the design and implementation of an electronic signature system with React, Mongo and Express whose objective is to decrease the time required to onboard new employees and streamline the hiring process.
• Developed a web application with PHP, MySQL and SOAP to automate the access to payroll history for internal employees, drastically reducing the workload for the payroll department.
• Designed and developed a JS application to enable customers to access real-time analytics of employee attendance which improved customer satisfaction and eliminated the need of manual reports.
• Developed a JavaScript-based signage system using Electron and React to stream job listings, pictures and news in real time to more than 20 offices.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon EC2 · Amazon S3 · Skill Development

positions.title: Fullstack Web Developer
positions.description:
- Work closely with the founders to spec and implement core products and features. 
- Implement new interfaces and functionality from the ground up, including the APIs. 
- Contribute to the development of our front and backend architecture using modern development practices.

positions.title: System Analyst
positions.description:
•Researched about new technolgies and different ways to improve the performance and usability of existing applications and APIs.
•Developed a patient experience platform that made easier to keep track of issues related to patient satisfaction.
•Designed, developed and deployed a rails application that enabled employees to provide feedback about current projects and possible issues in their departments.

positions.title: Computer Sales Associate
positions.description: Going above and beyond to provide excellent customer service and finding the right tech solution for each customer.

positions.title: Computer Sales Associate
positions.description: My main duty was to create a complete solution of both hardware and software based on the customer need. To excel on customer support and the sales process.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description: It was my first close experience in the IT field. My main duties included to assist the Senior IT staff on multiple matters, as well as being the entry level support for end users.

projects.title: WordPress Site - non-profit
projects.description: Website built for a non-profit organization in order to help with brand establishment and to provide the management team with an user friendly way to update content. A custom theme and different plugins were used to add extra functionality and usability to the site.

projects.title: Tiange - eCommerce
projects.description: Web application built with Ruby on Rails 5 and some of its new features including ActionCable to implement live updates in certain parts of the application. Different gems were used to add an extra level of security within the different layers of the site. The application is fully responsive to provide the users with a good experience across devices.
